lines: Supreme, abiding beyond, depthless, beginningless, one —
cave-lodged and manifold, home of all: O Śambhu, to You I come for refuge.
notes: first L4 verse of the work — owner verdict requested before continuing (rules 15/17)
sanskrit_cite: paraṃ parasthaṃ gahanād anādim | sarvālayaṃ sarvacarācarasthaṃ tvām eva śambhuṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye

lines: Whirled from womb-dwelling to death's end on the sorrow-wheel —
the student asked the blessed Lord, the ground: the supreme truth.
notes: second verse; first-verse verdict pending — same voice, same song

lines: In the support-verses the teacher spoke its pith to him —
Abhinavagupta tells it in Śiva's teaching view.
notes: third verse; first-verse verdict still pending — same voice, same song
sanskrit_cite: ādhārakārikābhiḥ taṃ gurur abhibhāṣati sma tatsāram | kathayaty abhinavaguptaḥ śivaśāsanadṛṣṭiyogena

lines: From the weight of his own power's glory, the fourfold egg divided:
power, Māyā, nature, earth — thus the Lord displayed.
notes: fourth verse; first-verse verdict still pending — same voice, same song
sanskrit_cite: nijaśaktivaibhavabharād a.ṅdacatuṣṭayam idaṃ vibhāgena | śaktir māyā prakṛtiḥ pṛthvī ceti prabhāvitaṃ prabhuṇā

lines: There within lies the world — skein of varied bodies, senses, worlds;
and there the enjoyer, embodied: Śiva himself, wearing the beast.
sanskrit_cite: tatrāntar viśvam idaṃ vicitratanukaraṇabhuvanasaṃtānam | bhoktā ca tatra dehī śiva eva gṛhītapaśubhāvaḥ

lines: As stainless crystal takes all colors for its own —
so the Lord wears every form: god, man, beast, and plant.
sanskrit_cite: nānāvidhavarṇānāṃ rūpaṃ dhatte yathāmalaḥ sphaṭikaḥ | suramānuṣapaśupādaparūpatvaṃ tadvad īśo 'pi

lines: When waters run, the moon runs; when waters still, stillness goes —
so this self, great Lord, in the mass of bodies, senses, worlds.
sanskrit_cite: gacchati gacchati jala iva himakarabimbaṃ sthite sthitiṃ yāti | tanukaraṇabhuvanavarge tathāyam ātmā maheśānaḥ

lines: As unseen Rahu, standing on the moon, shines forth —
so the all-pervading self, through sense-things, shines in mind's mirror.
sanskrit_cite: rāhur adṛśyo 'pi yathā śaśibimbasthaḥ prakāśate tadvat | sarvagato 'py ayam ātmā viṣayāśrayaṇena dhīmukure

lines: As a face shines in a stainless mirror —
so the self is light itself, in a mind made pure by Śiva's falling grace.
sanskrit_cite: ādarśe malarahite yadvad vadanaṃ vibhāti tadvad ayam | śivaśaktipātavimale dhītattve bhāti bhārūpaḥ

lines: Formed of light, whole, at rest in self, in bliss profound —
brimmed with will and knowing and doing, powers without end.
sanskrit_cite: bhārūpaṃ paripūrṇaṃ svātmani viśrāntito mahānandam | icchasaṃvitkaraṇair nirbharitam anantaśaktiparipūrṇam
